description: The level of an alert as a function of structured source fields (s6mt). A reading is (source, fields): kev is the CISA KEV catalog entry of a CVE id, ghsa is api.github.com/advisories/<GHSA id>, osv is api.osv.dev/v1/vulns/<id>. 'fields' lists each source's exact keys; a value the source does not state is null, a list is empty, and no value is derived. Every string is printable ASCII (U+0020 to U+007E); a reading with any other character is malformed, so no Unicode version decides what a name binds to. kev.name is vendorProject and product, each trimmed, joined by one space, or null when the catalog does not list the CVE. ghsa.repository is owner/repo, lowercase, of the repository advisory the entry came from. packages is a list of {ecosystem, name, range, first_patched} in ascending order of that tuple by code point, null counting as the empty string, each entry once; ecosystem is lowercase and may be empty. cwes is ascending, each once, and [] when the source states none. withdrawn_at and withdrawn are null or the UTC time the source states (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS[.fraction]Z); cvss_vector is null or a complete CVSS 3.0, 3.1 or 4.0 vector (every base metric of the version, each once, with a value it defines; 4.0 also fixes their order); a reading with any other value there is malformed and supports nothing. A reading supports a product only when kev.name, or a package's ecosystem:name (name alone when the ecosystem is empty), equals one identity of spec/scope.json; a withdrawn reading (withdrawn_at, withdrawn) supports it at level none. 'sources' is the authoritative-source table: the first row whose source and 'when' match classifies the reading for that product. 'alone' is the highest level the class sets; no rule adds two readings up, so the level of several readings is the highest one of them gives; 'lowers': false marks a source the subject's attacker can write, which never sets above notice and whose change or withdrawal justifies no lowering. 'rules' is the level table: the first row whose class and 'when' match gives the level, else notice; the result is capped by the class's 'alone' and by 'tier_cap' for the product's scope tier. Conditions: type (ghsa.type equals), vendor_own (github.com/<repository>/ is one of the product's authority prefixes), id_prefix, tier (the product's tier is listed), cwe_any, severity_in, cvss_av (the CVSS vector's attack vector is listed), patched (a package of this product has a first patched version). 'reading_cap' is the highest level a model's reading of prose may give; a reading never makes a critical and never justifies a lowering. 'ttl_days' is how long a level stands after its last confirmation. The ruleset digest is the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of {"ruleset": this file, "scope": spec/scope.json}. Any change to either file is a new version, pinned by the trust root. Version 1 is the only version this reader evaluates.
